main_text.l: Ǫ[?]rinx addidit Mozdarus, recensét Sharestanius, scil. إبطال إعجاز القران من
جهة الفصاحة والبلاغة quod nullum in Alcorano miraculum agnosceret respectu
eloquentiæ & elegantiæ. At non ille primus vel solus
in hac sententia fuit. Idem asseruit AlNodhamus,
referentibus iisdem, scil. quod ad إعجاز القران seu illud
quod in Alcorano pro miraculo habendum انه من حيث الاخبار عن الامور الماضية والآتية ومن جهة صرف الدواعي عن المعارضة ومنع
العرب عن الاهتمام به جيرا وتعجيزا ان لو خلاهم لكانوا قادرين علي ان ياتوا بسورة من مثله بلاغة Esse respectu narrationum quæ in eo ha-
bentur, de rebus præteritis & futuris, & respectu
aversionis [seu quòd averteret Deus illos] qui illud sibi ar-
rogarent, ne cum eo [eloquentia scil.] contenderent, &
potenter cohibuerit Arabes quo minus illud in animum
inducerent, cùm si illos sinvisset, potuissent certè proferre
caput aliquod ei elegantiâ, eloquentiâ & compositionis
venustate par. Verba sunt AlSharestanii, sic & Author
AlMamakes, Dixit, (inquit) AlNoddham صرفهم عنها
مع قدرتهم Aversit ab hoc eos [Deus] cùm illud a-
liàs facere potuissent. Inter varias autem Mohammed-
anorum de Alcorano suo sententias, minimè prætere-
yunda est illa AlJahedhi (sectæ AlJahedhianorum pa-
tris ac seste Sharestanio) من فضلاء المعتزلة
والمصنف è clarissimis Motazalorum, multarumque libro-
rum authoris, scil. ان القران جسن يجوز ان يقلب مرة
رجلا ومرة حيوانا Esse Alcoranum corpus quod
converti

marginalia.note: Sub Almotasa-mo et AlMota-waccelo Chalifis floruit.

page.notes: The first word has a large decorative initial that I could not identify with confidence; it is marked [?]. The Arabic text is my best reading of a small, partly worn print. Individual Arabic letters and diacritics may be wrong and are not marked in every case. The marginal note "Sub Almotasa-mo" is placed beside the line where it stands on the scan. The word "praetereunda" is broken at the line end as printed, and I have kept the reading "præterey" with a hyphen-free join; the printed break may be "praeter-" + "eunda", so please check that join. The catchword "converti" stands alone at the right below the last full line.
